title: Berkeley Annual General Adjustment for Year 2026 (1.0%)
requirement: Eligible landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0%, no earlier than January 1, 2026, under the 65%-of-CPI formula; Regulation 1148 qualifying conditions and tenant notice apply.
coverage_conditions: Eligible landlords of units with 2025 permanent rent ceilings under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance, except tenancies begun on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies to existing tenancies; the 2026 AGA may not adjust rents of tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

exemptions: Tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
